BiblicalUsage: Noah is one of the five daughters of Zelophehad, named with Mahlah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. They have no brothers, so they come to Moses and ask for an inheritance among their father's brethren — and God gives it to them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the daughters of Zelophehad change the law by asking: Noah's name stands in the roll of those who claimed what God said was theirs.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
